programmes.evidence: Official current programme page explicitly names PhD in Administration – Logistics and Operations Management, a 90-credit doctoral specialization offered jointly with Concordia, McGill and UQAM. The verified department links directly to it. Explicit doctoral research includes healthcare/service operations, SCM, humanitarian logistics, production/distribution planning and applied operational research.
limitations: A specialization within the joint PhD in Administration, not a separate broad degree title. The joint training partnership is not used to merge participating institutions.
